description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of three models, namely "struct", "Audio-Reasoner", and "Qwen-2.5-Omni", across two categories, MMAU and MMAR. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, with the model names listed below each pair of bars. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 10 to 70, marked at intervals of 10. Each model is associated with a pair of bars, with the darker blue bar representing MMAU and the lighter blue bar representing MMAR. The MMAU bars have values of approximately 55%, 75%, and 80% for "struct", "Audio-Reasoner", and "Qwen-2.5-Omni", respectively, while the corresponding MMAR bars have values of around 40%, 55%, and 80%. The bars are grouped by model, with the MMAU and MMAR bars appearing side by side for each model. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the models, but the bars are consistently colored according to their respective categories.
